howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把技术性内容拆成大白话来讲,覆盖是谁、是什么、在哪里、为什么、什么时候这几个方面。
howto.when: 当你觉得某段技术内容难懂、想让它用大白话把 who、what、why 等讲清楚时,这个技能就会接管。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude breaks technical material down into plain English, covering the who, what, where, why, and when of it.
howto.when_en: Use it when something technical sounds hard to follow and you want a plain-English breakdown of who, what, why, and the rest.
